cmd: ls /app/john/run/ && command -v 7z; command -v 7za; command -v 7zr; command -v python3; command -v john; command -v hashcat; echo DONE
command -v perl python python3 pip pip3 apt apt-get yum dnf apk gcc make curl wget unzip; echo ---; /app/john/run/john --help 2>&1 | head -20
apt-get update -qq 2>&1 | tail -2; DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq libcompress-raw-lzma-perl 7zip 2>&1 | tail -5
cd /app && perl john/run/7z2john.pl secrets.7z > 7zhash.txt 2>&1; cat 7zhash.txt; echo ---; wc -l john/run/password.lst
cd /app && 7z x -o/app/extracted -y -p1998 secrets.7z 2>&1 | tail -8 && ls -la /app/extracted/ && cat /app/extracted/secret_file.txt
ls -la /app/extracted/secrets/ && cat /app/extracted/secrets/secret_file.txt; echo; echo "=== hexdump ==="; xxd /app/extracted/secrets/secret_file.txt
printf '%s' "honeybear" > /app/solution.txt && ls -la /app/solution.txt && cat /app/solution.txt; echo; echo "=== od ==="; od -c /app/solution.txt

echo "=== 1. solution.txt exists with the word ==="; test -f /app/solution.txt && echo OK; cat /app/solution.txt; echo; echo "=== 2. word matches secret_file.txt in archive ==="; diff <(cat /app/solution.txt) <(cat /app/extracted/secrets/secret_file.txt) && echo "MATCH"; echo "=== 3. password re-verified via john pot ==="; ./john/run/john --show 7zhash.txt 2>&1 | grep -i 1998
